correctness.rationale: Strict scalar mean internality gives finite-cycle consensus. Fourier diagonalization of the centered logarithmic Jacobian gives exact radius rho, and quadratic remainder estimates improve an initial (rho+eta)^k bound to O(rho^k). A nonzero rotating top-mode coefficient survives for small perturbations, proving sharpness; the unique zero-radius case converges supergeometrically. 54,076 finite checker diagnostics supplement rather than replace the full proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The statement adds both an all-means sharp upper rate and a noncancellation lower witness for each mean. Neither follows by a uniform quantitative estimate from the cited qualitative convergence results; the special binomial formulas supply only instances, while the current linearization-plus-quadratic argument handles every Kubo–Ando mean. Yamazaki 2019 §5 already gives the scalar update and weighted special-case binomial formula, but not a theorem uniform across nonlinear means asserting exact spectral worst-case rates and constructive asymptotic lower bounds.
